Hi Alex / Team - thanks for the clear questions. Quick answers and a couple of clarifying items so we can route the SIG accurately:

1) SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II in Q4 2025. We can share a redacted PDF under NDA - link above. If your legal team needs the full report we can route through our portal and require a signed NDA.

2) HIPAA / BAA: Redwood supports HIPAA-covered workloads. We do sign a BAA; draft available on request. If you plan to send PHI into the service, please flag which API endpoints and estimated volumes so we can advise on best practices (data minimization, encryption at rest/in transit, retention controls).

3) Data residency: Our hosted API runs in multiple regions. We offer EU-hosted options for customers requiring EU residency, and we also support Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments for stricter requirements. If Meditech needs EU-only storage/processing, please indicate which environments will be in-scope.

4) SIG turnaround: typical initial pass on a SIG/CAIQ is 3 business days once we receive the completed spreadsheet and any requested evidence. Complex or custom controls sometimes add additional time.

Two clarifying asks to help us answer the SIG precisely:
- Will Meditech be sending PHI/PHI-equivalent data? Yes/No. If yes, please list which data types (e.g., patient identifiers, lab results).
- Which Meditech team will be the primary point-of-contact for follow-ups (name, email, phone)?

If helpful I’m available for a 30-min sync with your InfoSec team today or tomorrow morning.

Regards,
